title: STROBE 2007 flow diagram schema
description: A schema for generating STROBE 2007 flow diagrams.

diagram_type.description: The type of diagram to generate.

exposed_group_potentially_eligible.description: Number of potentially eligible participants in the exposed group.

exposed_group_assessed_for_eligibility.description: Number of participants in the exposed group assessed for eligibility.

exposed_group_excluded.description: Number of participants in the exposed group excluded.

reasons_for_exposed_group_exclusion.description: Reasons for exclusion in the exposed group.

exposed_group_included.description: Number of participants in the exposed group included in the study.

exposed_group_lost_to_follow_up.description: Number of participants in the exposed group lost to follow-up.

reasons_for_exposed_group_loss_to_follow.description: Reasons for loss to follow-up in the exposed group.

exposed_group_analysed.description: Number of participants in the exposed group analysed.

unexposed_group_potentially_eligible.description: Number of potentially eligible participants in the unexposed group.

unexposed_group_assessed_for_eligibility.description: Number of participants in the unexposed group assessed for eligibility.

unexposed_group_excluded.description: Number of participants in the unexposed group excluded.

reasons_for_unexposed_group_exclusion.description: Reasons for exclusion in the unexposed group.

unexposed_group_included.description: Number of participants in the unexposed group included in the study.

unexposed_group_lost_to_follow_up.description: Number of participants in the unexposed group lost to follow-up.

reasons_for_unexposed_group_loss_to_foll.description: Reasons for loss to follow-up in the unexposed group.

unexposed_group_analysed.description: Number of participants in the unexposed group analysed.

box_color.description: The background color of the boxes.

font_color.description: The color of the text in the boxes.

font_name.description: The name of the font to use for the text.

font_size.description: The size of the font to use for the text.
